label: new rows only
detail: One statement every 250 ms (SQLite's data_version) asks whether anything committed; raw rows are then read from the last one pushed onward.

label: pushes rows
detail: Into an in-memory replay that runs the parser's own code.

label: hidden ids cut
detail: Card ids in the opponent's hand and library are removed first; the keys are an allow-list of 37 paths. Marked in amber: a test fails if snapshot keys differ from that list.
Joined with card facts and the record, which the same poll reads from the file when needed; sent only when it differs.

label: channel
detail: The only thread crossing: a channel send and a repaint request.

label: draws
detail: Library, Opponent, Record and Status, from display rules in the core library.
